target.title: Apply Claw update reconciliations
target.body:
## Summary

- Implements the consent-gated mutating side of the Claws update/reconcile track from [RFC #27](https://github.com/openclaw/rfcs/pull/27), stacked after [#102959](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/102959).
- Allows `claws update <claw> --from <manifest> --yes` to revalidate the dry-run plan, install supported target artifacts, reconcile artifact provenance refs, update managed workspace/persona files, and remove stale unchanged managed workspace files.
- Keeps unsafe cases fail-closed: required blockers, target diagnostics, manual workspace edits, missing `--workspace` for workspace updates, stale removal errors, and workspace write conflicts all stop the mutating update.

## Stack

[RFC #27](https://github.com/openclaw/rfcs/pull/27) -> [#101328 validation/dry-run](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101328) -> [#101755 apply/provenance](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101755) -> [#101973 workspace/persona apply](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101973) -> [#102228 plugin installers/uninstall warnings](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/102228) -> [#102296 status/remove](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/102296) -> [#102306 export/creation](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/102306) -> [#102383 skill artifacts](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/102383) -> [#102406 MCP artifacts](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/102406) -> [#102427 doctor diagnostics](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/102427) -> [#102959 update dry-run](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/102959) -> this PR

## Behavior

`claws update --dry-run` remains the read-only planning surface from #102959. This PR adds the `--yes` path:

1. read and validate the target manifest
2. rebuild the update plan and fail on not found, blocked, manual, or diagnostic states
3. require `--workspace` when the reconcile plan includes workspace/persona entries
4. validate target workspace writes before artifact mutation
5. install supported target artifacts
6. remove stale managed workspace files only when unchanged, retaining modified files
7. write/update target workspace files
8. persist the final target artifact provenance with stale Claw refs removed
9. emit `openclaw.clawUpdateResult.v1`

Notably, artifact provenance is not advanced until workspace reconciliation succeeds, so a failed update does not make `claws status` report the target version or target artifact refs.

## Validation

- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/cli/claws-cli.test.ts src/claws/update-plan.test.ts src/claws/provenance.test.ts`
- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/claws/schema.test.ts src/claws/provenance.test.ts src/claws/artifact-installers.test.ts src/claws/workspace.test.ts src/claws/lifecycle-state.test.ts src/claws/update-plan.test.ts src/state/openclaw-state-db.test.ts src/cli/claws-cli.test.ts src/cli/plugins-cli.uninstall.test.ts src/claws/lifecycle.e2e.test.ts src/claws/doctor.test.ts src/flows/doctor-core-checks.test.ts src/flows/doctor-health-contributions.test.ts src/cli/program/command-registry.test.ts src/cli/program/root-command-descriptions.test.ts`
- `git diff --check && node scripts/check-no-conflict-markers.mjs && pnpm exec oxfmt --check --threads=1 src/cli/claws-cli.runtime.ts src/cli/claws-cli.test.ts src/claws/lifecycle-state.ts src/claws/provenance.ts src/claws/update-plan.ts`
- `node_modules/.bin/tsgo --noEmit --pretty false` reaches inherited `src/secrets/config-io.ts(12,17)` TS4058 after this patch's local type issue was fixed.
- `codex review -c model=gpt-5.5 --uncommitted` reported no actionable correctness issues after fixes for same-id workspace moves, deferred provenance persistence, and the update-result logger type.

## Real behavior proof

```json
{
  "schemaVersion": "openclaw.clawUpdateResult.v1",
  "clawVersion": "2.0.0",
  "updateSummary": {
    "totalEntries": 2,
    "added": 0,
    "changed": 1,
    "removed": 1,
    "unchanged": 0,
    "manual": 0,
    "blocked": 0,
    "skippedUnsupported": 0
  },
  "resultSummary": {
    "totalEntries": 1,
    "recordedArtifactRefs": 0,
    "appliedWorkspaceFiles": 1,
    "previewOnlyEntries": 0,
    "skippedUnsupported": 0,
    "blockedEntries": 0,
    "provenanceRecords": 1,
    "removedWorkspaceFiles": 1,
    "retainedWorkspaceFiles": 0
  },
  "removedWorkspaceFiles": [
    {
      "entryId": "old",
      "action": "deleted"
    }
  ],
  "soul": "updated soul\n",
  "oldExists": false
}
```
